intro.text: A slave Kaladin knew, who died in a slave revolt that Kaladin led.

items.text: One night Kaladin led Goshel and the other slaves in a revolt against their masters. Every slave but Kaladin was killed, and the defeat made Kaladin stop trying to escape. Months afterwards he still thought about Goshel often and felt he had failed him.
While trying to speak his fourth Ideal, Kaladin remembered Goshel among the people he had lost, along with Malop, Jaks, Beld, Pedin, Rod, Mart, Nalma, Dallet and his old squad, and Tien.
